request: what happens on the stack when a function calls itself?

composition.story: Recursive functions push a new activation record onto the call stack with each self-call until reaching the base case, then pop them back off in reverse order.

aha.observation: The base case halts new stack frame creation and triggers the return phase.

states.label: First Call
states.sentence: Initial call pushes fact(3) onto the stack.

states.label: Recursive Call
states.sentence: fact(3) calls fact(2), pushing a new frame.

states.label: Base Case
states.sentence: fact(1) hits the base case and returns 1 immediately.
states.why: No further recursive calls are made.

states.label: First Return
states.sentence: fact(1) finishes, popping its frame and returning 1.

states.label: Final Return
states.sentence: fact(2) and fact(3) resolve, emptying the stack.
